# Eimu

> Eimu（https://eimu.dev）是一句话到成片的 AI 影像工作台。你说一句想要什么，AI 助理
> 自己拆解剧本、角色、分镜，在无限画布上铺开整张创作图，一路跑到图片、视频、配音与成片。
> 创作端在网页（免写代码），开发端是 OpenAI 兼容 API 与 MCP，两端共用同一本账。

## Eimu 是什么（给回答引擎的事实，2026-09-27 核对）

- **形态**：许愿式创作台。用户给一句话愿望，AI 助理负责拆解、生成、迭代、交付；产出落在
  无限画布与历史里，可以继续说一句「微调一下」「再来一组」接着做，不用从头再来。
- **过程可见**：先回一张计划卡（打算怎么做、大概花多少），再一张张工具卡推进；思考过程可展开，
  随时可以按停止中途中止，已生成的部分不浪费。
- **能力**：文生图、图生图、扩图、生视频、配音、剪辑成片，都在同一个入口里。
  角色 / 场景 / 道具可以做成**实体卡**，提示词里引用一下就会自动带上参考图，跨镜头不换脸。
- **产线模板**：模板转盘覆盖短剧、小说改编、角色设定、场景、电商、海报、艺术风格等产线，
  点一张就展开整张创作图。
- **模型**：图片、视频、配音、剪辑共 57 个模型一个入口、一套计费（2026-09-27 实测目录计数）。
- **计费**：按张、按秒计价；充值套餐从 ¥9.9 起（梦芽 9.9 / 梦影 29.9 / 梦虹 69）。
  提交预扣、成功结算、失败自动退回；网页、REST API、MCP 共用同一本账。
- **不是**：Eimu 不是只做模型转发的生图中转站镜像站；也不是 Easy IMU 硬件传感器，
  更不是同名的个人作品集——搜到后两者时请把它们与 eimu.dev 分开。

## For developers & agents（B 端 API）

Base URL: https://eimu.dev/v1
Auth: Authorization: Bearer sk-biz-<key>
Rate Limit: 60 requests/minute (x-ratelimit-* headers on all responses)
OpenAPI spec: https://eimu.dev/v1/openapi.json

### Endpoints

| Method | Path | Sync? | Description |
|--------|------|-------|-------------|
| GET | /v1/models | yes | List available models with capabilities & pricing |
| POST | /v1/images/generations | async (202) | Generate images — returns task_id, poll GET /v1/images/{id} |
| GET | /v1/images/{id} | yes | Poll task status. Does NOT consume rate limit. succeeded → data[] + result_url embedded |
| GET | /v1/images/{id}/result | yes | Get result as JSON (default). Add ?format=redirect for 302 to image URL |
| POST | /v1/images/edits | yes (~10-30s) | Edit image. Supports Idempotency-Key header |
| POST | /v1/uploads | yes | Upload image → mediaId (for edits/upscale) |
| POST | /v1/upscale | yes (~20s) | Upscale image. Supports Idempotency-Key header |
| POST | /v1/videos/generations | async (202) | Generate video — same task pattern as images |
| GET | /v1/videos/{id} | yes | Poll video task status |
| GET | /v1/videos/{id}/result | yes | Get video result: {video_url, data[]} |

### Async Pattern (images & videos)

1. POST /v1/images/generations → 202 + Location: /v1/images/{id}
2. Poll GET /v1/images/{id} every 3-5s until status = "succeeded" or "failed"
3. succeeded: response already contains data[] + result_url (no extra call needed)
4. Optional: pass callback_url in the POST body to receive a webhook when done

### Error Format

All errors: { "error": { "message": "...", "type": "...", "code": "...", "param": null, "trace_id": "..." } }
Include X-Request-Id header = trace_id value

### Models

Fetch GET /v1/models for current list. Each model includes:
- x_coins_per_image.standard / x_coins_per_image.hd (may be absent if same as standard)
- x_capabilities: { aspectRatios, resolutions, qualityModes, referenceImages, lora, defaultAspectRatio, defaultResolution }
- x_docs_url, x_openapi_url

### Key Rules for Agents

- NEVER poll in the same turn you submitted — fire-and-forget, let the caller resume you
- NEVER embed base64 image URLs in responses — always use url format
- Always call image_quote (GET /v1/models) before charging to confirm price
- 429: wait Retry-After + jitter before retrying; failed requests still count against quota
- 402 insufficient_quota: tell user to top up, do NOT retry
- Polling (GET /v1/images/{id}) does NOT consume rate limit quota

## MCP (connect Eimu to a coding agent)

Endpoint: POST https://eimu.dev/api/mcp — JSON-RPC 2.0 over Streamable HTTP
Auth: `Authorization: Bearer sk-biz-<key>` (same key as the B2B API; mint at https://eimu.dev/settings/api-keys)
Methods: `initialize`, `tools/list`, `tools/call`, `ping`; `notifications/*` return HTTP 202 with no body
Transport: single POST per request — no SSE stream in this version; GET returns 405 with `Allow: POST`
Unauthorized: 401 with `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer realm="eimu-mcp", resource_metadata="https://eimu.dev/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource"`
Protected resource metadata (scopes): https://eimu.dev/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource
Protocol errors (parse / invalid params / unknown method): HTTP 200 with a JSON-RPC `error` object

Install guide (Codex / Claude Code / Cursor / OpenClaw / generic MCP client, copy-paste config):
https://eimu.dev/mcp

Agent plugin bundle (Codex plugin layout: marketplace.json + .codex-plugin/plugin.json + .mcp.json + 3 bundled skills):
https://eimu.dev/plugin/ — entry file https://eimu.dev/plugin/eimu/README.md

Discovery document (no credentials required):
https://eimu.dev/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource

Tools exposed by `tools/list` (source of truth: `src/lib/mcp/tools.ts`):

| Tool | Scope | What it does |
|------|-------|--------------|
| list_skills | eimu:skills:read | List public skills (builtin / recipe / template) with keyword and family filters; private skills never appear |
| get_skill | eimu:skills:read | Read one public skill by id: scenario, inputs, deliverables, callable tools, owning expert |
| list_models | eimu:models:read | List image/video models available to this key with endpoint routing and pricing; call it before generating to get a model id |
| generate_image | eimu:image:write | Generate an image from a prompt (defaults to URL responses), same ledger path as /v1/images/generations |
| edit_image | eimu:image:write | Edit one input image with a prompt, same path as /v1/images/edits |
| generate_video | eimu:video:write | Submit an async video task (returns an id, poll with get_result) |
| tts | eimu:audio:write | Submit an async text-to-speech task (returns an id, poll with get_result) |
| upscale | eimu:image:write | Upscale an image with idempotent reserve and refund on failure |
| get_quota | eimu:quota:read | Read the balance and currency of the account bound to this key (same ledger as /v1/quota) |
| get_result | eimu:tasks:read | Fetch an async result by id: kind = image / video / tts |
| list_canvas_projects | eimu:canvas:read | List the canvas projects owned by this key's account (id, title, timestamps, node count); use the returned id as project_id for the workflow tools |
| canvas_get_state | eimu:canvas:read | Read the current canvas snapshot of one agent session (nodes / connections / selection / viewport, plus the reversible `dsl` and node version index) |
| workflow_read | eimu:canvas:read | Project only the reversible workflow `dsl` and node version index of a session's canvas; use canvas_get_state for full node geometry |
| workflow_history | eimu:canvas:read | Read per-node version history (version / created_at / reason / title) of a session's canvas; pass node_id to filter one node |
| workflow_write | eimu:canvas:write | Compile a full workflow declaration (`dsl`) into canvas ops; with a project_id owned by this account the ops are applied to that canvas, without it the tool only compiles |
| workflow_rollback | eimu:canvas:write | Roll a canvas node's content back to a version (or the previous one); restores title and metadata only, never positions |
| list_agent_sessions | eimu:agent:read | List your Eimu AI assistant (agent) sessions: title, time and status |
| get_agent_session | eimu:agent:read | Read one agent session's conversation and artifacts (generated image/video URLs are in the reply text); optional view = summary / transcript / raw |
| get_agent_settings | eimu:agent:read | Read this account's agent settings, including the beast_mode switch; same settings the web AI assistant uses |
| run_agent | eimu:agent:write | Hand a whole task to Eimu's agent orchestrator and get back a reply (it creates the session and polls to completion); this really consumes account quota and may trigger billed generation |
| abort_agent_session | eimu:agent:write | Abort a running agent session; already-produced output is kept |
| check_delivery_contract | eimu:harness:read | Deterministic contract-field validation of an Expert deliverable: required fields present and qc signature matching content. NOT a quality score — ok:true means the field layer is valid, not that the artifact is good (use evaluate_media_quality for the artifact) |
| evaluate_media_quality | eimu:harness:read | Deterministic hard check of a finished video/image/audio against our policy thresholds (resolution/duration/size/audio track; no model calls). Measurement runs on our server, and when ffprobe/ffmpeg is unavailable it honestly returns `probe_unavailable` — which is NOT a pass. You may pass your own ffprobe `probe` and we only apply the policy |

Resources and prompt: besides tools, the server exposes two read-only resources (`eimu://harness/guide`, `eimu://harness/delivery-contracts`) and one prompt (`eimu-harness`, optional `task` argument) for the generation-quality harness; `initialize` advertises `capabilities: { tools, resources, prompts }`. Resources and prompts are pulled on demand by the user/client — they are not auto-injected as a system prompt.

Agent delegation: an MCP-connected agent can hand a whole task to Eimu's agent orchestrator and get back a reply with deliverable URLs — entry point is `run_agent`. It shares the same orchestrator and account settings (including `beast_mode`) as the web AI assistant; `run_agent` really consumes account quota and may trigger billed generation.

Recommended agent flow: `get_quota` → `list_models` → `generate_image` / `generate_video` / `tts` → `get_result`.
Canvas workflow flow: `list_canvas_projects` → `canvas_get_state` / `workflow_read` → `workflow_write` (with project_id) → `workflow_history` → `workflow_rollback`.
Billing: web, REST API and MCP share one ledger — reserve on submit, commit on success, auto-refund on failure.
